description: A script for synchronizing sightings between multiple MISP instances, including functions for searching, pushing, and verifying sightings, as well as managing drift timestamps.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a PyMISP instance with provided URL, key, and verification setting.

methods.name: search_sightings
methods.description: Searches for sightings within a specified date range and extends sightings with attribute UUIDs.

methods.name: sync_sightings
methods.description: Synchronizes sightings to the authoritative MISP instance, optionally verifying before pushing.

methods.name: push_sighting
methods.description: Pushes a sighting to the authoritative MISP server.

methods.name: sighting_exists
methods.description: Checks if a sighting exists on the authoritative server (currently always returns False).

methods.name: set_drift_timestamp
methods.description: Saves the current timestamp to a local drift file.

methods.name: get_drift_timestamp
methods.description: Reads the last drift timestamp from a local file.
